description:

name: Tarkett
description:
Tarkett flooring

Tarkett is one of Europe's leading flooring manufacturers: vinyl, LVT, SPC, linoleum, parquet, laminate and carpet for homes, offices, schools, hospitals and sports venues. As official resellers we offer the whole range, with technical data sheets and clear prices per pack.

name: Resilient flooring
description:
Tarkett resilient flooring

Homogeneous and heterogeneous vinyl, vinyl rolls and linoleum: resilient floors that are comfortable underfoot, withstand heavy traffic and are easy to clean. They are the most common choice for schools, hospitals, shops and offices, and work well for home renovations too.

name: Homogeneous vinyl
description:
Tarkett homogeneous vinyl flooring

A single compact vinyl layer, welded and glued to the subfloor: the toughest floor for corridors, schools and healthcare buildings with very heavy traffic. It can be dry-buffed, which cuts maintenance. Slip-resistant, acoustic and static-control versions are also available.

name: Heterogeneous vinyl
description:
Tarkett heterogeneous vinyl flooring

Several layers, one printed in high definition: woods, stones and colours for every style, in rolls or tiles. The TopClean XP surface treatment protects against wear and stains, for schools, hospitals, shops and homes. Slip-resistant and acoustic versions are also available.

name: Sheet vinyl
description:
Tarkett vinyl flooring rolls

Iconik vinyl rolls are designed for renovations: plenty of designs, from woods to classic patterns, and glue-free installation up to 50 m², so the floor is easy to remove and recycle at the end of its life.

name: Linoleum
description:
Tarkett linoleum flooring

Tarkett linoleum is made of 94% natural raw materials (linseed oil, wood and cork flour, resins) following a recipe dating back to 1898. Comfortable and long-lasting, with marbled designs in vivid colours and the xf² treatment for easier cleaning. Cradle to Cradle certified.

name: Modular flooring
description:
Tarkett modular flooring

Planks and tiles to click, glue or loose lay: Tarkett SPC, LVT, parquet and laminate. Modular installation is quick, the floor can be walked on straight away and a damaged piece can be replaced without redoing the whole floor.

name: SPC
description:
Tarkett SPC flooring

Click SPC planks with a rigid core and great strength: they can be laid over most existing floors, ceramic tiles included, and can be walked on immediately. Easy-clean ultra-matt finish and an integrated acoustic underlay that reduces footstep noise.

name: Loose-lay LVT
description:
Tarkett loose-lay LVT flooring

Loose-lay LVT planks and tiles that stay in place thanks to their weight and stable construction, fixed only with a removable tackifier. Quick installation and single pieces replaceable in minutes: ideal for shops, offices and hotels.

name: Glue-down LVT
description:
Tarkett glue-down LVT flooring

LVT planks and tiles installed with permanent adhesive for maximum long-term stability. They combine wear resistance, easy maintenance and contemporary design, with very realistic woods and stones: suitable for homes and commercial spaces alike.

name: Interlocking LVT
description:
Tarkett interlocking LVT flooring

LVT tiles with a dovetail interlocking joint, sturdy and fast to install even without glue. Designed for commercial, industrial and high-traffic areas: they withstand loads, are easy to clean and a single tile can be replaced in no time.

name: Parquet
description:
Tarkett parquet

The beauty and warmth of real wood, with the stability of a multilayer construction that limits movement caused by humidity. Tarkett planks click together and have protective finishes that make them durable and easy to clean.

name: Laminate
description:
Tarkett laminate flooring

Laminate floors made in Germany, with a wide choice of designs for every style. The protective top layer resists wear, scratches and stains and makes cleaning simple: a beautiful and practical solution for the home.

name: Textile flooring
description:
Tarkett textile flooring

DESSO by Tarkett carpet tiles and broadloom for offices, hotels and public spaces. They improve room acoustics, are comfortable underfoot and combine with other Tarkett floors for coordinated projects.

name: Carpet tiles
description:
Tarkett DESSO carpet tiles

DESSO by Tarkett carpet tiles, from a brand with over 85 years of experience: many patterns and colours, modular installation and easy replacement of single tiles. They improve acoustics and comfort in offices and coordinate with other Tarkett floors. Many collections are Cradle to Cradle certified.

name: Broadloom carpet
description:
Tarkett DESSO broadloom carpet

High-performance DESSO by Tarkett broadloom carpet, to cover large areas seamlessly in hotels, offices and meeting rooms. Soft underfoot, sound-absorbing and easy to combine with other Tarkett floors.

name: Specialist solutions
description:
Tarkett specific solutions

Floors designed for particular needs: sports surfaces, wet-room systems, wall protection, slip-resistant, acoustic and static-control floors, plus a selection of the most easily recyclable products and solutions for transport vehicles.

name: Sports flooring
description:
Tarkett sports flooring

Surfaces for every sport and level, from multi-purpose gyms to professional basketball courts. They meet industry standards for athlete performance and safety, last a long time and need little maintenance, with a wide choice of colours.

name: Aquasens - Wet room system
description:
Aquasens: Tarkett wet-room system

Slip-resistant floors, wall coverings and accessories designed to work together in bathrooms, showers and changing rooms. The Aquasens system ensures a watertight, hygienic and safe installation with a refined look.

name: Wall coverings
description:
Tarkett wall coverings

Vinyl wall coverings that protect walls from knocks, scratches and stains in busy areas, flexible and easy to install. The TopClean treatment makes cleaning easier and the colours coordinate with Tarkett floors. The ProtectWall 2CR collection is approved for cleanrooms.

name: Static control
description:
Tarkett static-control flooring

Static-conductive and static-dissipative homogeneous vinyl and linoleum for sensitive environments: operating theatres, server rooms, electronics labs. Resistant to heavy traffic, easy to maintain and coordinated with other Tarkett ranges.

name: Safety flooring
description:
Tarkett slip-resistant safety flooring

Slip-resistant floors for areas at risk of slipping, barefoot or with shoes: homogeneous vinyl to keep costs down or heterogeneous vinyl for more design choice, in classes A, B, C, R10 and R11. Safetred Spectrum tiles combine safety with the convenience of tile installation.

name: Acoustic flooring
description:
Tarkett acoustic flooring

Acoustic vinyl, linoleum and textile floors, in rolls or tiles, that reduce impact noise and improve sound absorption. They resist indentation and are comfortable underfoot: ideal for offices, schools, hotels and healthcare buildings.

name: Circular Selection
description:
Tarkett Circular Selection

A selection of Tarkett's most sustainable products: made partly from recycled materials and designed to be easily recycled at the end of their life, following circular-economy principles that reduce waste and pollution.

name: Transportation
description:
Tarkett transportation flooring

Tarkett solutions designed for ships, aircraft, buses and trains, where lightness, durability and safety are essential. In addition to the standard collections, designs can be customised for each application.

name: Accessories
description:
Tarkett accessories

Everything you need to complete the installation: skirting boards, profiles, welding rods, underlays, accessories for sports floors and wet rooms, plus adhesives and tools for installation and maintenance.

name: Skirting
description:
Tarkett skirting boards

Rigid and flexible skirting boards in various shapes and heights, for a precise finish on LVT, homogeneous and heterogeneous vinyl, wood and linoleum floors.

name: Profiles
description:
Tarkett profiles

Transition, end and stair profiles that give the installation its finishing touch, for vinyl rolls or tiles, linoleum, parquet and laminate.

name: Welding rods
description:
Tarkett welding rods

Rods to seal the joint between two sheets, on floors and wall coverings: versions for vinyl, sports and linoleum surfaces.

name: Underlays
description:
Tarkett technical underlays

Underlays to level the subfloor, act as a moisture barrier or improve sound insulation. Suitable for vinyl rolls and tiles; some also for linoleum and difficult subfloors such as old wooden floors.

name: Sports accessories
description:
Tarkett sports accessories

End and transition profiles for sports surfaces, in different versions for each type of floor, to be completed with wooden or PVC skirting.

name: Wet room accessories
description:
Tarkett wet-room accessories

Drains, grates, outlets and traps in various sizes to install floors and wall coverings safely and watertight in bathrooms, showers and changing rooms.

name: Installation and maintenance products
description:
Tarkett installation and maintenance products

Adhesives, tools and products to install every type of Tarkett floor correctly and keep it looking good over time.
